[package]
name = "libsignal-account-keys"
authors = ["Signal Messenger LLC"]
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "Operations for various account-associated keys"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(tokio_unstable)"]

[dependencies]
displaydoc = "0.2.5"
hkdf = "0.13.0"
hmac = "0.13.0"
protobuf = "3.7.2"
rand = "0.9.4"
sha2 = "0.11"
static_assertions = "1.1"
subtle = "2.6"
thiserror = "2.0.11"

[dependencies.libsignal-core]
path = "rust/core"

[dependencies.signal-crypto]
path = "rust/crypto"

[dependencies.argon2]
features = ["zeroize"]
version = "0.5.0"

[dependencies.derive_more]
features = ["from"]
version = "2.0.0"

[dependencies.partial-default]
features = ["derive"]
version = "0.1.0"

[dependencies.password-hash]
features = ["getrandom"]
version = "0.5.0"

[dependencies.rand_core]
features = ["os_rng"]
version = "0.9"

[dependencies.serde]
optional = true
features = ["derive"]
version = "1.0.203"

[dependencies.zerocopy]
features = ["derive"]
version = "0.8.33"

[dev-dependencies]
assert_matches = "1.5"
const-str = "1.0"
criterion = "0.5"
proptest = "1.7"
test-case = "3.3"

[build-dependencies]
protobuf-codegen = "3.7.2"

[[bench]]
name = "hash"
harness = false

[package]
name = "libsignal-core"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = ["Signal Messenger LLC"]
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
edition = "2024"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(tokio_unstable)"]

[dependencies]
displaydoc = "0.2.5"
log = "0.4.21"
rand = "0.9.4"
sha2 = "0.11"
subtle = "2.6"
thiserror = "2.0.11"
uuid = "1.5"

[dependencies.libsignal-debug]
path = "rust/debug"

[dependencies.curve25519-dalek]
features = ["digest"]
version = "5.0"

[dependencies.derive_more]
features = ["from", "into", "try_from"]
version = "2.0.0"

[dependencies.x25519-dalek]
features = ["static_secrets"]
version = "3.0"

[dependencies.zerocopy]
features = ["derive"]
version = "0.8.33"

[dev-dependencies]
assert_matches = "1.5"
const-str = "1.0"
criterion = "0.5"
hex = "0.4.3"
proptest = "1.7"

[dev-dependencies.boring]
version = "5.0"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.boring-sys]
version = "5.0"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.clap]
features = ["derive"]
version = "4.4.11"

[[bench]]
name = "curve"
harness = false

[package]
name = "libsignal-debug"
edition = "2024"
version = "0.99.1"
authors = ["Signal Messenger LLC"]
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
rust-version = "1.88"

[dependencies]
cfg-if = "1.0.0"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(tokio_unstable)"]

[features]
enabled = []

[package]
name = "poksho"
version = "0.7.0"
authors = ["Signal Messenger LLC"]
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(tokio_unstable)"]

[dependencies]
curve25519-dalek = "5.0"
hmac = "0.13.0"
sha2 = "0.11"

[dev-dependencies]
hex = "0.4.3"
criterion = "0.5"
rand = "0.9.4"

[[bench]]
name = "sho"
harness = false

[package]
name = "signal-crypto"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = ["Signal Messenger LLC"]
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"

[dependencies]
derive_more = "2.0.0"
displaydoc = "0.2.5"
hkdf = "0.13.0"
hmac = "0.13.0"
hpke-rs = "0.7"
hpke-rs-crypto = "0.7"
rand_chacha = "0.9"
rand_core = "0.9"
sha1 = "0.11"
sha2 = "0.11"
subtle = "2.6"
thiserror = "2.0.11"
zeroize = "1.8.2"

[dependencies.libsignal-core]
path = "rust/core"

[dependencies.libsignal-debug]
path = "rust/debug"

[dependencies.aes]
features = ["zeroize"]
version = "0.9.1"

[dependencies.cbc]
features = ["alloc", "zeroize"]
version = "0.2.1"

[dependencies.ctr]
features = ["zeroize"]
version = "0.10.1"

[dependencies.ghash]
features = ["zeroize"]
version = "0.6.0"

[dev-dependencies]
assert_matches = "1.5"
const-str = "1.0"
criterion = "0.5"
hex = "0.4.3"
rand = "0.9.4"
serde = "1.0.203"
serde_json = "1.0.45"

[[bench]]
name = "aes_gcm"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "hpke"
harness = false

[package]
name = "zkcredential"
version = "0.1.0"
authors = ["Signal Messenger LLC"]
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
rust-version = "1.85"
edition = "2024"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(tokio_unstable)"]

[dependencies]
cfg-if = "1.0.0"
derive-where = "1.6.1"
displaydoc = "0.2.5"
sha2 = "0.11"
subtle = "2.6"
thiserror = "2.0.11"

[dependencies.poksho]
path = "rust/poksho"

[dependencies.curve25519-dalek]
features = ["serde"]
version = "5.0"

[dependencies.partial-default]
features = ["derive"]
version = "0.1.0"

[dependencies.serde]
features = ["derive"]
version = "1.0.203"

[dependencies.rayon]
optional = true
version = "1.8.0"

[dev-dependencies]
bincode = "1.3.2"

[[bench]]
name = "endorsements"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "zkcredential_benchmarks"
harness = false

[package]
name = "zkgroup"
version = "0.9.0"
authors = ["Signal Messenger LLC"]
license = "AGPL-3.0-only"
rust-version = "1.85"
edition = "2024"
description = "A zero-knowledge group library"

[lints.clippy]
cast_possible_truncation = "warn"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(fuzzing)", "cfg(tokio_unstable)"]

[dependencies]
aes = "0.9.1"
aes-gcm-siv = "0.11.1"
bincode = "1.3.2"
const-str = "1.0"
derive-where = "1.6.1"
displaydoc = "0.2.5"
hex = "0.4.3"
hkdf = "0.13.0"
rand = "0.9.4"
rayon = "1.8.0"
sha2 = "0.11"
static_assertions = "1.1"
subtle = "2.6"
thiserror = "2.0.11"
uuid = "1.5"

[dependencies.libsignal-account-keys]
features = ["serde"]
path = "rust/account-keys"

[dependencies.libsignal-core]
path = "rust/core"

[dependencies.poksho]
path = "rust/poksho"

[dependencies.zkcredential]
features = ["rayon"]
path = "rust/zkcredential"

[dependencies.curve25519-dalek]
features = ["lizard", "serde"]
version = "5.0"

[dependencies.derive_more]
features = ["from", "try_from"]
version = "2.0.0"

[dependencies.partial-default]
features = ["derive"]
version = "0.1.0"

[dependencies.serde]
features = ["derive"]
version = "1.0.203"

[dependencies.base64]
optional = true
version = "0.22.1"

[dev-dependencies]
assert_matches = "1.5"
criterion = "0.5"
test-case = "3.3"

[dev-dependencies.uuid]
features = ["v5"]
version = "1.5"

[[bench]]
name = "zkgroup_benchmarks"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "serialization"
harness = false

[[bin]]
name = "generate_server_params"
required-features = ["base64"]

[[bin]]
name = "generate_generic_server_params"
required-features = ["base64"]
